reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and no redline or comment was proposed — consistent with the playbook's treatment of compliant clauses as internal evidence rather than negotiation issues.

Cited text supports the classification: Sections 2.1(b) and 2.2(a) extend the grant to Ono's Affiliates and to Third Party manufacturers acting on Ono's behalf, satisfying the affiliate/contractor requirement.

No at-will revocation: Array's termination rights are limited to uncured material breach and bankruptcy, and Section 13.1 converts the Section 2.1 licences into fully paid-up, irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free licences on expiry.
Successor-transfer element is met by Section 18.9, which permits assignment without consent to an acquirer of substantially all business or assets.

The residual point (Array consent for Third Party Sublicensees/distributors without an express reasonableness qualifier) is correctly noted in the rationale as a sub-element rather than escalated to a deviation; deterministic checks are consistent with the finding.
